runs.note: one process, arms in the order 16,1,8,2,4,16

caveats: The solver is not run-to-run deterministic (conservative transport CAS float sums), so the reference trajectories of the three processes differ. Every sensitivity number is one step from ONE shared input state inside its own process; nothing here compares trajectories.
The extrapolator clamps the sweep budget to min(max(dims),16)=16, so no arm above 16 can be measured from outside lib/.
Cost arms each run their own 30-frame trajectory, so a whole-frame wall difference mixes the cheaper extension with a different flow; the extension-stage timestamps are the direct measurement.

At these defaults (liquid capacity balancing off) the N=16 reference itself carries a population of grossly overfull cells (V up to ~118 on mini64), so max |dV| per cell is reported both raw and restricted to cells where both fields are <= 1.5.

sensitivity.bucketBasis: max(0, phi) at the MAC face centre from the input vertex phi, in cells
sensitivity.normalisation: max |u_component| over the N=16 packed transport shell, which equals the largest seed (liquid face) speed that frame
